segments.text: PApists teach that men by workes of grace may merit life eternall, and increase of iustification in this life. But howe can this be? for here we see that euery bit of bread which we eate, is the free gift of God without any merit of ours. Now, if we can not merit a peece of bread, what madnes is it to thinke that we can merit life euerlasting.

2. They also are deceiued who thinke; that any thing comes by meere
chance or fortune, without Gods prouidence. Indeede in respect of men who know not the causes of things, many chances there are: but so, as that they are ordered and come to passe by Gods prouidence. Luk. 10.31. By chance there came downe a certaine priest that way.
